podcast.title: Canadian Two-Piece Band
podcast.body: The Blue Stones are mentioned as one of the Canadian two-piece rock bands that exemplify the trend of duos making significant noise in the 21st century. "A lot of this new generation were Canadian. Black pistol fire, death from above 1979. Japan droids, the PAKAD, USS Duortang, the Blue Stones."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 100 Greatest Rock Moments of the Millennium So Far - Part 6: (50-41)
